Under its target image for 2030, "EIKEN Vision 2030," it has set three focus business areas: "Contributing to cancer prevention and treatment," "Contributing to the eradication of infectious diseases and infection control," and "Providing products and services useful for healthcare." It has formulated a five-year management plan, with the fiscal year ending March 2027 as the first year and the fiscal year ending March 2031 as the final year, and since April 2026 it has been working to strengthen earnings in domestic business, accelerate growth in overseas business, and evolve its business portfolio through M&A and alliances.
